Bring a little of that magical New York autumn feeling into your home with these pictures above fireplace — three beautifully illustrated scenes capturing the Big Apple at its cosiest, with ochre-toned falling leaves, warm greige buildings and soft grey cityscapes all working together in perfect harmony. There is something so inviting about this set; it tells a story, and every time you glance up at the mantelpiece you will feel like you are strolling through Central Park on a crisp October morning.

I love how the warm ochre and golden-toned leaf illustrations carry the eye across all three prints, making them feel like a proper set rather than three separate pictures thrown together. The colour palette — creamy off-white backgrounds, muted charcoals, deep forest greens on the coffee shop frontage, and those rich amber and ochre foliage tones — is earthy and grounded, never garish. It will sit beautifully above a fireplace but would look equally at home in a hallway or living room too.

What's Included with Pictures Above Fireplace New York Autumn Ochre Travel Wall Art Prints | "Autumn in New York" | Set of 3

  • A set of 3 individual New York autumn travel art prints, illustrated in a warm watercolour-style featuring a Manhattan brownstone street scene, a cosy NYC coffee shop facade, and the iconic New York City skyline — all united by ochre and amber autumn foliage tones
  • Printed in the UK using fade-resistant pigment inks for lasting, vivid colour — designed for indoor display
  • If you choose the framed or canvas-wrapped option, your prints arrive ready to hang straight out of the box, saving you the hassle of hunting for frames that fit
  • Choose between unframed and framed options in multiple sizes and in Luster or Museum quality; also available in wrapped canvas size options

How to Style Pictures Above Fireplace with This New York Set

My favourite way to hang this set is in a straight horizontal row above the fireplace, all three at the same height with an equal gap — around 5 to 8 cm between each print looks lovely and keeps things neat without feeling too tight. Because the background of each print is a soft off-white, they work beautifully against both warm white and cool light grey walls, and that ochre in the leaves will really sing if you have any warm wood tones or burnt-orange accents elsewhere in the room. If your mantelpiece is quite wide, go for the larger sizes so the prints fill the wall confidently rather than looking lost up there.

This set also works a treat in a hallway or a home office if the fireplace room is already quite busy — anywhere you want a warm, well-travelled feel without it being loud or overwhelming. For more travel-inspired wall art ideas, have a browse through our travel wall art collection — there are loads of cities and styles to mix or match with this New York set.

Choosing the Right Size and Finish for Your Wall

Before you decide on a size, I always suggest measuring the width of your fireplace opening and aiming for the combined width of the three prints (plus gaps) to sit roughly two-thirds to three-quarters of that span — it looks considered and balanced rather than accidental. If your room has high ceilings and a tall chimney breast, go a size up from what you first think; prints often look smaller on a wall than they do in your hand.

For finish, Luster paper gives a gentle sheen that brings out those warm ochre and golden tones beautifully in most living rooms, while Museum quality paper has a matt surface that feels more gallery-like and works especially well if you get a lot of natural light on the wall. The wrapped canvas option is a great pick if you want a contemporary, frame-free look — the autumn palette looks brilliant wrapped at the edges. Scroll down to see how each size looks above a fireplace before you decide — there is a size-guide image below showing every option in that setting.

What are pictures above fireplace?

Pictures above fireplace are wall art prints hung on the chimney breast or the wall directly above the mantelpiece, used to turn that natural focal point of a room into a considered, styled display. They are one of the most popular ways to add personality and warmth to a living room, as the fireplace wall is often the first thing guests notice when they enter. A set of three prints — like this New York autumn collection — works especially well above a fireplace because the grouped arrangement fills the space confidently while keeping the look cohesive. Choosing prints with a warm, unified palette means the display feels intentional and pulls the whole room together rather than competing with the decor around it.

How to Hang Pictures Above a Fireplace: A Simple Step-by-Step Guide

1. Measure your wall space: Measure the width of the chimney breast above your mantelpiece. Aim for your arrangement of prints to span roughly two-thirds of that width so the display looks balanced and intentional — not too small, not crammed edge to edge.

2. Find the right height: Position the bottom edge of your prints around 15 to 20 cm above the mantelpiece shelf. This leaves breathing room between the shelf and the art and stops the display from looking cramped. If your mantel shelf is deep, go a little higher so nothing gets obscured by items on the shelf.

3. Map out the arrangement before you drill: Cut out paper templates the same size as your prints and use low-tack tape to hold them on the wall. Step back and check the spacing and height look right in the actual room — it takes two minutes and saves you filling unnecessary holes later.

4. Keep gaps consistent: For a set of three like this New York autumn collection, aim for an even gap of 5 to 8 cm between each print. Use a spirit level and a tape measure to keep everything straight — even a slight lean is very noticeable at eye level above a fireplace.

5. Hang and enjoy: Once you are happy with the layout, mark your fixing points, put in your hooks or picture pins, and hang your prints. Stand back and enjoy the view — this is always the best bit.

Which Option Is Right for You? Comparing Our Wall Art Print Formats

Ready to hang straight away — Framed print: Yes, arrives ready to hang. Wrapped canvas: Yes, arrives ready to hang. Unframed print: No, you will need to source your own frame.

Frame included — Framed print: Yes. Wrapped canvas: No frame needed — canvas wraps around a wooden stretcher bar. Unframed print: No — print only.

Paper / surface options — Framed print: Luster art paper or Museum quality paper. Wrapped canvas: Canvas wrap (no paper choice needed). Unframed print: Luster art paper or Museum quality paper.

Best for — Framed print: A classic, polished look above the fireplace with no extra effort. Wrapped canvas: A contemporary, frameless display with a gallery feel. Unframed print: Buyers who want to choose their own frame or already have one.

Finish feel — Framed print: Traditional and neat — works with most interior styles. Wrapped canvas: Modern and textured — great for relaxed or contemporary rooms. Unframed print: Flexible — the finish depends entirely on the frame you choose.
